fact: The landscape assessment report dated January 2023, on 246 facilities assessed in 16 districts (202 primary, 34 secondary, 10 tertiary), states that all 34 secondary and all 10 tertiary facilities had M&E officers whose role was predominantly data capture and upload on DHIS 2, with a similar role among M&E officers at the district health management teams; it states DHIS 2 was deployed in 96% of the facilities surveyed.
title: Health Data Ecosystem Mapping: National Digital Health Landscape Assessment Report, Sierra Leone
publisher: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH, Digital Innovation in Pandemic Control (DIPC)
